ironfurnaces: Faster tiered furnaces with augments for the first smelting line
Keep a compact smelting bank useful beside Create, IE and Mekanism processing without a new ore route
utilitarian: Small workshop utilities: fluid hopper, well-behaved dropper, redstone clock, TPS meter, tiny fuels and trowel
Low-cost glue for Create and redstone projects; trader carpets and outpost claim blocks keep settlements orderly
createaddition: Electric motor, alternator, rolling mill and wires that bridge Create rotation with FE
Convert a Create drivetrain into FE for IE, Mekanism and Powah workshops, and drive kinetic lines from FE later
create_enchantment_industry: Liquid experience, mechanical grindstone, blaze enchanter and forger on the Create line
Automate enchanting with Create fluids beside Ars and EvilCraft; book printing stays bounded by liquid XP cost
industrialforegoing: Plastic, latex and machine frames for agriculture, mob and resource automation
Mob duplicator needs an ecosystem capsule (IV); the ore laser base a spectral lens (IV); the fluid laser base a power regulator (III)
powah: Energizing orb, crystals and tiered generators, cells and cables
Niotic capacitors add Twilight ironwood (IV), spirited Nature's Aura sky ingot (V) and nitro Mekanism atomic alloy (V), so high generators follow acts
mekanismtools: Tools and armour from Mekanism's osmium, bronze, steel, refined glowstone and refined obsidian
Gives the Mekanism processing chain durable personal equipment without a new ore
fluxnetworks: Priority-managed wireless FE plugs, points and storages across dimensions
Plugs and points each consume a power regulator (III); the controller that charges player inventories a routing matrix (III)
ironjetpacks: Tiered FE jetpacks built from cells, thrusters and capacitors
The strap needs a power regulator (III); elite coils Aether zanite (IV); ultimate coils Mekanism atomic alloy (V)
mininggadgets: FE laser mining gadgets with upgrade cards
All three gadgets consume a power regulator (III); size, fortune and range upgrades keep native late ingredients
justdirethings: Goo-transformed ferricore, blazegold, celestigem and eclipse alloy tools, machines and upgrades
Portal guns need a routing matrix (III), the flight upgrade a horizon chart (IV), the time wand a renewal engine (V) and the paradox machine an Ark bus (V)
compactmachines: Pocket rooms that hold a workshop inside one block
The personal shrinking device needs a handling core (III); rooms remain an optional compact-base tool, not an expedition dimension
hostilenetworks: Trained data models simulate mob drops without spawning entities
The simulation chamber needs an ecosystem capsule (IV), matching the staged RFTools spawner and IF duplicator
draconicevolution: Draconic fusion crafting, energy cores, reactor, dislocators and wyvern to chaotic equipment
Wyvern cores need an Ark bus (V), awakened cores a renewal engine (V) and dislocators a routing matrix (III); chaotic gear keeps its Chaos Guardian drops

qol.torchmaster: Dread lamps and feral flare lanterns for settled bases; the companion's Altar of Peace replaces the mega torch

notes.source: All pins come from the read-only ATM10 8.1 reference instance at E:/curseforge/Instances/All the Mods 10 - ATM10 (G:/curseforge is a junction to the same folder). SHA-1 matched its installed CurseForge metadata before pinning; licenses, dependency ranges and sides were read from each JAR and CurseForge file metadata. No reference-pack script, quest, configuration or asset is included.
notes.dependencyClosure: New libraries resolved from the same instance: Cloth Config (Powah), Brandon's Core and CodeChicken Lib (Draconic Evolution) and Create: Dragons Plus (Create: Enchantment Industry). Titanium, Placebo, Cucumber, GuideMe, Create and Mekanism were already pinned.
notes.staging: tools/generate_family_balance.py rewrites only the native recipe IDs listed in docs/design/industrial-expansion-family.md into pack/kubejs/server_scripts/entrelumen_industrial_balance.js. Each change fills an empty slot or replaces one repeated ingredient; serializer, result, count and other ingredients stay native. Acts are acquisition guidance, never a use or gift restriction.
notes.exclusions: Oritech, Ender IO (8.2.11 beta), Modern Industrialization, Extreme Reactors with ZeroCore 2, Applied Flux, Productive Trees, Super Factory Manager, Industrial Foregoing Souls, Create: New Age and Generator Galore stay out; reasons are in the family design note.
